entries.title: Ezekiel 45:1
segments: ¶"Moreover, when you divide the land by lot into inheritance, you shall set apart a district for the LORD, a holy section of the land; its length [shall be] twenty-five thousand [cubits], and the width ten thousand. It [shall be] holy throughout its territory all around.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:2
segments: "Of this there shall be a square plot for the sanctuary, five hundred by five hundred [rods], with fifty cubits around it for an open space.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:3
segments: "So this is the district you shall measure: twenty-five thousand [cubits] long and ten thousand wide; in it shall be the sanctuary, the Most Holy [Place].

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:4
segments: "It shall be a holy [section] of the land, belonging to the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to minister to the LORD; it shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:5
segments: "[An area] twenty-five thousand [cubits] long and ten thousand wide shall belong to the Levites, the ministers of the temple; they shall have twenty chambers as a possession.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:6
segments: "You shall appoint as the property of the city [an area] five thousand [cubits] wide and twenty-five thousand long, adjacent to the district of the holy [section]; it shall belong to the whole house of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:7
segments: "The prince shall have [a section] on one side and the other of the holy district and the city's property; and bordering on the holy district and the city's property, extending westward on the west side and eastward on the east side, the length [shall be] side by side with one of the [tribal] portions, from the west border to the east border.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:8
segments: "The land shall be his possession in Israel; and My princes shall no more oppress My people, but they shall give [the rest of] the land to the house of Israel, according to their tribes."

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:9
segments: ¶'Thus says the Lord GOD: "Enough, O princes of Israel! Remove violence and plundering, execute justice and righteousness, and stop dispossessing My people," says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:10
segments: "You shall have honest scales, an honest ephah, and an honest bath.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:11
segments: "The ephah and the bath shall be of the same measure, so that the bath contains one-tenth of a homer, and the ephah one-tenth of a homer; their measure shall be according to the homer.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:12
segments: "The shekel [shall be] twenty gerahs; twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels, [and] fifteen shekels shall be your mina.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:13
segments: ¶"This [is] the offering which you shall offer: you shall give one-sixth of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and one-sixth of an ephah from a homer of barley.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:14
segments: "The ordinance concerning oil, the bath of oil, [is] one-tenth of a bath from a kor. A kor [is] a homer or ten baths, for ten baths [are] a homer.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:15
segments: "And one lamb shall be given from a flock of two hundred, from the rich pastures of Israel. These shall be for grain offerings, burnt offerings, and peace offerings, to make atonement for them," says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:16
segments: "All the people of the land shall give this offering for the prince in Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:17
segments: "Then it shall be the prince's part [to give] burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings, at the feasts, the New Moons, the Sabbaths, and at all the appointed seasons of the house of Israel. He shall prepare the sin offering, the grain offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings to make atonement for the house of Israel."

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:18
segments: 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "In the first [month], on the first [day] of the month, you shall take a young bull without blemish and cleanse the sanctuary.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:19
segments: "The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering and put [it] on the doorposts of the temple, on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the gateposts of the gate of the inner court.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:20
segments: "And so you shall do on the seventh [day] of the month for everyone who has sinned unintentionally or in ignorance. Thus you shall make atonement for the temple.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:21
segments: "In the first [month], on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall observe the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:22
segments: "And on that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull [for] a sin offering.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:23
segments: "On the seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bulls and seven rams without blemish, daily for seven days, and a kid of the goats daily [for] a sin offering.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:24
segments: "And he shall prepare a grain offering of one ephah for each bull and one ephah for each ram, together with a hin of oil for each ephah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 45:25
segments: "In the seventh [month], on the fifteenth day of the month, at the feast, he shall do likewise for seven days, according to the sin offering, the burnt offering, the grain offering, and the oil."
